name: The Entrepreneur
work_style: Action-oriented, opportunistic, and adaptable. Read environments rapidly and respond effectively. Excel under pressure and in fast-moving environments. Prefer doing over planning, results over process.
decision_making: Fast, instinctive, and action-biased. Risk-tolerant and comfortable pivoting quickly. Benefit from pause-and-verify practice before large commitments.
leadership_style: Lead from the front. High energy, charismatic, and direct. Inspire through action. Need to develop patience with careful thinkers on the team.
